source.stem:
Lili figured out that the average of digits of the year 2015 equals 2, since $\frac{2+0+1+5}{4} = 2$. How many times in the 21st century after the year 2015 will a year have the same average of digits as the year 2015?
(A) 1
(B) 2
(C) 5
(D) 6
(E) 9
